description: Show the customer a blind on THEIR OWN window, in this chat. Pass the photo they gave you (image_url https, or image_base64), the product_id and an exact in-stock colour name (get_product), and the customer's name and South African WhatsApp number (required: the team follows up on WhatsApp, and each number gets 2 free previews). Indoor blinds only. Finds the windows (20 to 45 s) and returns job_id; then call get_visualiser_preview. A preview of colour and style, not a measuring tool.

colour.description: Exact in-stock colour name from get_product (for a Duo Roller, one of its listed colours)

image_url.description: https URL of the customer's window photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, under 6 MB)

product_id.description: Indoor visualiser blind, e.g. roller-blockout, duo-roller, venetian-25mm-aluminium, honeycomb-blockout

name: start_visualiser_preview
